Why an intensive?

An intensive session nets a personalized ritual, safe usage education, and a routine you can lean on. We prioritize gentle, evidence-conscious language and sensible dilution.

Who it’s for

Curious beginners, ritual seekers, and anyone who wants a carefully vetted scent approach (pets/pregnancy considerations discussed).

What you’ll feel

Clarity around scent choices, confident home use, and a handcrafted blend to support daily ritual — not medical treatment.

How the session flows — a cozy map

1. Pre-chat

A short intake form to note sensitivities, medications, pregnancy/pets, and scent history.

2. In-person intake

We do a scent exploration, safety discussion, and dilution plan. Patch testing is demonstrated when needed.

3. Blending

We craft your blend together; you watch and learn the technique to replicate safe dilutions at home.

4. Follow-up

One short check-in to refine your formula and answer questions about use and storage.

"Thoughtful, grounded, and so clear about safety. I left with a blend I actually use nightly."
— L., local client
"A gentle teacher. I appreciate how dilution and pregnancy considerations were handled."
— M., workshop attendee
"Practical, not woo. Helpful for introducing scent into my mindfulness routine."
— J., returning client

Questions I hear most

Dilution — what do you recommend?

We follow safe dilution guidelines (typical topical blends range from 1–5% depending on use, age, and sensitivity). Your session includes a personalized dilution plan. This is educational and not medical advice.

Do I need a patch test?

Patch testing is recommended for topical blends, especially if you have sensitive skin. We will demonstrate and document patch test instructions during the session.

What about pets?

We take pets seriously. Certain oils can be irritating; we’ll discuss safe placement of diffusers and pet-friendly choices. If you have severe pet sensitivities, we’ll adapt recommendations.

Pregnancy & breastfeeding notes

Some oils are best avoided in pregnancy or breastfeeding. We screen for pregnancy and will adjust blends accordingly. Always consult your healthcare provider alongside aromatherapy guidance.

Grab the Starter Checklist

Free PDF: "Safe Home Aromatherapy — A Practical Checklist" — tips on storage, dilution, and beginner blends.

Safety & common questions

How do I dilute these blends?

Typical topical dilutions vary by age and intended use. We provide specific dilution guidance per blend during consultations. For general reference: adults often use 1–3% for daily topical blends; reduce for children and sensitive skin. This information is educational, not medical advice.

Do I need to patch test?

Yes: patch testing is a simple, recommended step before regular topical use. Apply a diluted small amount to an inconspicuous area and wait 24–48 hours for reactions.

Are these blends pet friendly?

Some plants and oils can be problematic for pets. We suggest using diffusers in well-ventilated spaces, keeping them away from sleeping areas, and selecting pet-compatible options when needed. Discuss your household pets during a session.

Pregnancy & breastfeeding — what should I know?

Certain oils should be avoided or used with caution in pregnancy and breastfeeding. We screen for this and will customize blends accordingly. Always consult your healthcare provider in conjunction with aromatherapy guidance.

Want a one-page blend guide?

Sign up to receive a printable with dilution tips and blend pairing ideas.

Shop FAQs — safety first

How should I dilute if I want to use oils topically?

We include basic dilution guidance with kits. Typical adult topical dilutions are 1–3% for everyday blends, reduced for sensitive skin, children, or pregnancy. Always follow the product leaflet and perform a patch test.

What’s a patch test and how do I do it?

Apply a diluted small amount to the inside of the forearm and monitor for 24–48 hours for redness or irritation. Discontinue if irritation occurs.

Are these products safe around pets?

Some oils may affect animals. Use diffusers in well-ventilated rooms, avoid prolonged exposure in small enclosed areas, and consult us if you have concerns about specific household pets.

Pregnancy & breastfeeding — are any products restricted?

Certain products contain oils we advise avoiding during pregnancy. Product notes will flag those oils; we recommend consulting your healthcare provider and contacting us for alternative suggestions.
